reviewer: research-director (Opus); recorded by the main session (Sonnet)
decision: accept as report-only; support gate not passed; A1 counts only; no dashboard, no article
scientific_meaning: At the 0.05 primary threshold the cloud wiper proxy marks 8 of 241 eligible drives on 7 days, and only 2 fuel-basis drives on 2 days, far below the floor of 20 drives on 10 days: A1 is not estimable. The A2 battery-side outcomes are counts only (6 drives). The exploratory darkness-proxy fuel difference is unresolved and moves with the definition of the first-drive-of-day flag.
allowed_wording: drives with wiper activity; a precipitation, spray or washing proxy
support gate not passed: 2 fuel-basis wiper-proxy drives on 2 days against a floor of 20 drives on 10 days; A1 counts only, not supported at this support
darkness and visibility proxy, mainly marks evening and winter driving: association only, interval includes zero, exploratory, sensitive to the first-of-day definition
SoC-ledger quantity, not a road-load measure (A2)
forbidden: rain, wet road, precipitation effect, weather effect, effect of darkness or night
no weather effect, no difference, equivalent (no TOST)
any dashboard, KPI or article use
quotable_now: only in the CHANGELOG and the analysis JSON; the gate counts; the darkness-proxy contrast only together with its interval, n (drives and days), the MDE, the rank-deficient resample count and the first-of-day sensitivity, labelled exploratory, unresolved, no pre-registered expectation; not a headline, not on the dashboard (no S.* key), not in the article
deviations_to_state: the eligibility was fixed after audit round 1 (10-row floor; zero-field test): 262 to 241 drives; the pre-outcome counts of spec Rev 2 7.1 (21 wet-proxy, 411 dry) used a broader base (no distance or class filter) and differ from the 8 and 212 of the eligible set: both are stated
12 drives with a missing ens_outlier_v2 are treated as clean (as in M769 and M770); excluding them gives 237 eligible and 6 wet-proxy drives
the M729 span rule is not applied; a 0.05 threshold means at least one wiper row; the source codes 6 and 7 are not separable
month fixed effects are nearly collinear with the wet proxy (1 to 3 per month; within-month share 0.96)
the first-drive-of-day flag is computed over the whole master; the darkness-proxy difference is sensitive to it (-0.114 versus -0.373)
the darkness-proxy contrast was rerun at the standing 4000 draws after the audit (it was 2000 in the first run)
the placebo has 2 wet-labelled drives: counts only
follow_ups: re-read the cloud streams for the M729 span rule and the wiper source codes 6 and 7
accumulate wiper-proxy drives; rerun A1 only when 20 fuel-basis drives on 10 days are reached
decide the first-of-day definition in a spec revision before any rerun of the darkness contrast
optional: an external precipitation record would need its own decision (no weather-service data are imported here)
